children: Further to the announcement made on 7 September 2026, the Board of Octopus Future Generations VCT plc (the “Company”) has reviewed the portfolio and announces that as at 30 June 2026, the unaudited Net Asset Value (“NAV”) of the Company was 84.4 pence per share, representing an increase of 4.2%.
